_documentation: See _config/README.md for setup instructions. Copy this file to ~/.claude/state/personal_config.json (Mac: ~/.claude/state/personal_config.json; Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.claude\state\personal_config.json) and fill in values. The live file is gitignored. Skills that depend on these values must refuse to run if a needed field is unset.

user.name: Your Name
aliases: Your nickname or initials, or 'you' / 'I' / 'me' for self-recognition in meeting transcripts
user.local_username: OS username (e.g. 'alex' for /Users/alex/ — used by /replication-package to strip absolute paths during sanitization)

notion.tasks_data_source_id: <uuid of the Tasks DB's data source — pass to mcp__notion__notion-query-database-view>
notion.tasks_parent_page_id: <32-char hex page ID of the page that holds the Tasks DB plus daily Brief children>

telegram._bot_token_lives_in: GitHub Actions secrets only, never in this file
